<script
dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
__html: `(${(() => {
const clock = document.getElementById('menubar-clock')
if (!clock) {
return
}
const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {
hour: '2-digit',
minute: '2-digit',
})
window.__INITIAL_TIME__ = time
clock.textContent = time
}).toString()})()`,
}}
/>
